_note: The spring plan: 23 weeks from the Monday after the Winter Showcase to the Glass House Ball (js/season15.js reads it once plan15's weeks are over; same shape as plan15.json). Between comps the loop is: the week after a comp starts with the judges' audio feedback (solo and trio) — listen with a grown-up, write the top fixes as notes on the dance — then one fix at a time until it shows on two videos in a row, full-outs and a mini audience, two clean runs on film before the next comp, and nothing new in the last days (taper weeks). School breaks are light weeks. Comp mode (js/mode.js) still takes over the seven days before each comp. Which comps the trio dances comes from data/events.json. Confirmed by Jenya (Oct 29, 2026): same solo all season, privates continue; the team auditions (Jun 4–6) are combos taught on the day, a technique class in front of the panel and improv — the solo and trio are not danced there — so the audition weeks (weeks[].audition, rules.audition) train pick-up, clean basics and improv, and nothing is filmed for the panel.

phases.g: Watch the Showcase video with a grown-up, pick two fixes. Press Play (Jan 15–17) is classes only. Two clean runs on film before Hollywood Connection, nothing new after Jan 19.

After every comp the judges' recordings come first: listen with a grown-up, write the top fixes on the dance's card, then one fix at a time until it shows on two videos in a row. Ryze and iD are a week apart: ONE fix between them.
Ryze and iD notes together, two fixes, two clean runs on film, nothing new after Mar 9. Gravit8 is required for PITCH.
Rest first, then the Gravit8 fixes one at a time, Hannah's videos once more to catch drift, spring break light, then full-outs, a mini audience and the taper into Hollywood Vibe.
One fix from Hollywood Vibe (or Ms. Brittany's last notes), two clean runs on film, nothing new after May 11.

Showstopper's notes first (they feed the Ball), then what the panel actually sees: combos taught on the day, a technique class and improv. A pick-up drill and two minutes of improv a day, the weakest trick on Fridays, then an easy audition week. The solo and trio aren't danced there.
Costume runs, a focal point for every section, the family mini show Thu Jun 17, then one run a day. The whole season on stage.

imagery.title: Show in your head (6 min)
script: Stand in your opening pose, in your dance clothes.
Play the real song, full speed.
Close your eyes. See the stage, the lights, the judges' table.
Dance it in your head through your own eyes; let your arms and head mark small.
Feel the story. Slow, calm breaths.
Hold the ending until the very last note.
Do it 2–3 times. The last time, watch yourself from the audience.
imagery.note: Picturing it at bedtime is extra and optional: never let it push bedtime later.

audition.pickup: 🧠 Pick-up drill: 8 counts from a class video — watch once, phone down, dance them from memory
audition.pickupHow: Any class video, or Hannah's walkthrough. Watch 8 counts once, phone down, do them back. Check, fix the one miss, once more. That's how the panel teaches: once through, then you.
audition.improv: 💃 Improv: 2 minutes to a song, eyes up, never stop
audition.improvHow: Any song, phone on the floor. Keep moving the whole 2 minutes, eyes to the judges' table; a wobble is a new move. Travel, go down to the floor and up, change speed.
